title: My Messages
encryptedNotice: End-to-end encrypted. Only you and the other person can read these.
nobodyYet: Nobody yet. A conversation opens once a message request is accepted.
ageLocked: Messaging is for people aged 13 and over, and this account has not answered that question yet.

requests.heading: Requests
requests.asked: They want to start a conversation.
requests.youAsked: You asked. Nothing is sent until they accept.
requests.youAskedToConnect: You asked to connect. Nothing changes until they accept.

newConversation.title: Start a conversation
newConversation.description: Somebody from a community you share, or anybody whose full handle you know.
newConversation.hint: A whole handle, number included, reaches somebody in none of your communities.
newConversation.empty: Nobody to show. You share no communities with anyone yet.

noHistoryHere: Nothing on this device yet. Messages you had elsewhere stay there.
sendFailed: That message could not be sent.
recipientHasNoDevice: {{name}} has not set up encrypted messages yet, so this could not be delivered.
deviceFailed: Encrypted messages could not be set up on this device.
unsupportedBrowser: Encrypted messages need a secure connection and a browser that can run them. Check the address starts with https (or is localhost), or try the app.

start.waiting: Waiting for them to accept. You can message each other once they do.
start.asksToMessage: They asked to message you. Accept, and the two of you can talk.
start.mayAsk: You haven't messaged them yet. Ask first — they can accept or decline, and nothing is sent until they do.
start.denied: You can't message them right now.

openFailed: That conversation could not be opened.

edit.editing: Editing this message. Escape to stop.

remove.title: Remove this message?
remove.body: It goes from this device, and their client takes it off theirs. A message they already read is a message they already read — this cannot unsay it.

historyRequest.title: One of your devices is asking for your messages
historyRequest.body: {{device}} signed in and has no history of its own. Send it this device's messages? Check the code below is the one it is showing you.
